entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet a while ago, and I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything. The color just isn't what I thought it would be, it doesn't match my bike at all. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. I'm just not sure what I'm supposed to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety. Let me just pull up your order. Do you have the order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. It's... VF-8675309.
Thank you. Let me see... I see the order for the AeroTech helmet, placed 71 days ago. Let me just confirm our current return policy for you.
Oh, 71 days? Is that too long? I get so overwhelmed with these things.

Not at all. According to our policy, standard items like this helmet are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're within that window, I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. What do I do now?

I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, we'll process your full refund.
Okay, I can do that. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
